subject: Trellis Bank: security onboarding request — IR playbook, SIG/CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@trellisbank.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: security@trellisbank.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Inquiry: IR playbook, SIG/CAIQ responses, and sample evidence

Hi Rafael,

We're beginning Trellis Bank's security onboarding and evidence intake for vendors ahead of our annual audit. Can you share Redwood's incident response playbook (IRP) and the SIG/CAIQ answers for the service? Our auditor has asked for:

- A copy of the IR playbook (redacted is fine) and an explanation of your escalation path for customer-impacting incidents.
- Your most recent SOC 2 report (we can accept a bridge letter if full report can't be provided).
- Completed SIG questionnaire or a summary CSV of responses for control families relevant to incident handling and logging.
- A small sample of telemetry/logs (sanitized) demonstrating log capture for an authentication event (UTC timeframe: 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-20).

Also please confirm retention windows for auth logs and whether you provide pre-signed S3 links for forensics or prefer a secure transfer (SFTP/SharePoint). We have a tight window — auditor wants materials by 2026-12-07.

If there are any redaction requirements or an internal contact for IR evidence handoff, please send them along.

Thanks,
Lisa Cho
InfoSec Manager — Vendor Risk
Trellis Bank
security@trellisbank.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@trellisbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T11:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: IR playbook, SIG/CAIQ responses, and sample evidence

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you've requested and hit the auditor's 2026-12-07 target. Quick summary of what we'll deliver and proposed timeline: 

- IR playbook (sanitized PDF) — attachment: IR_Playbook_Redwood_v1.3.pdf. Will include escalation path, L2/L3 contacts, and our customer-notify cadence.
- SIG responses — attachment: SIG_Response_Summary.xlsx (we'll include the control ids and short citations).
- SOC 2 — we can provide a bridge letter now and coordinate delivery of the full report with our legal team if needed.
- Log sample — we can produce a sanitized tarball and share via pre-signed S3 link (or SFTP if you prefer). Proposed file name: forensic-log-sample-20261127.tar.gz. Delivery ETA: 2026-11-30 (pre-signed link) or 2026-12-01 if you prefer SFTP.

A couple of clarifying questions so we scope redaction properly:
1) Do you need IP addresses redacted or pseudonymized?
2) Do you require user identifiers to be replaced with hashes?

Next steps: if S3 presigned is acceptable, I'll have Marissa prepare the sample and the forensic transfer instructions and attach them. If you need an NDA addendum or SOW for secure transfer, we've used DocuSign previously — I'll include a link.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@trellisbank.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T08:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: IR playbook, SIG/CAIQ responses, and sample evidence

Hi Lisa — looping in the engineering lead and the forensics owner so we can coordinate the extract.

We will provide the sanitized log sample and include a README with the mapping of fields and the exact filters used. A few operational notes: 

- Retention: auth logs are retained 180 days hot, 2 years cold archival (per our retention policy).
- Redaction: default redaction replaces user IDs with salted SHA256 hashes and removes public IPs on request. We can provide both versions (hashed + original IP masked) if your audit needs the correlation preserved across events.
- Forensics transfer: we will upload forensic-log-sample-20261127.tar.gz to a locked S3 bucket and generate a presigned URL valid for 72 hours. We'll include step-by-step instructions in forensic-instructions.txt.

I'm attaching the forensic-instructions.txt (brief) and will share the presigned link once available. If Trellis requires a stricter chain of custody we can coordinate an SFTP endpoint and an SLA for deletion after download.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer — Incident Response
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: forensic-instructions.txt (text/plain)
From: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@trellisbank.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: security@trellisbank.com
Date: 2026-11-29T15:40:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: IR playbook, SIG/CAIQ responses, and sample evidence

Rafael / Marissa — this looks good, thanks. Presigned S3 link is fine. For redaction please: 

- Mask public IP addresses (remove last octet) and provide hashed user IDs (we will accept salted SHA256).
- Please ensure timestamps are UTC in the sample.

We do require a quick data processing addendum (DPA) for transfer of telemetry. I'll route the DPA to your legal team; in the meantime please send the materials you have. Also if you can attach a short sanitized postmortem from a recent tabletop or small incident that illustrates your escalation and RCA cadence, that would help our auditor.

We will accept documents via DocuSign for the DPA — I'll attach that to the HubSpot record and request signatures. DocuSign link preferable for the DPA/SOW.

Best,
Lisa

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Cho <lisa.cho@trellisbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-02T10:00:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: IR playbook, SIG/CAIQ responses, and sample evidence — delivery

Hi Lisa — quick status update and delivery. Attached to this thread (and shared to the presigned bucket):

- IR_Playbook_Redwood_v1.3.pdf (sanitized)
- SIG_Response_Summary.xlsx (control mappings for incident & logging families)
- forensic-log-sample-20261127.tar.gz (presigned link sent separately: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-secure/presigned/forensic-log-sample-20261127.tar.gz)
- forensic-instructions.txt (transfer/README)
- sanitized-postmortem-trellis-sim.pdf (short tabletop postmortem illustrating our notify/escalation timeline)

DocuSign link for the DPA/SOW: https://app.docusign.com/s/trellis-sow-2026 — we'll sign and return the countersigned copy once received.

If Trellis needs anything redacted further for compliance, let us know and we'll produce a second sanitized package. Otherwise we expect this set to satisfy the auditor's ask for an initial intake.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
